# KALM Collective

KALM Collective is a South African retail storefront for the available KS Active Archive and the upcoming KALM Move collection.

## Primary pages

- https://kalmcollective.co.za/
- https://kalmcollective.co.za/collections/ks-active
- https://kalmcollective.co.za/collections/sale
- https://kalmcollective.co.za/brand/kalm-move
- https://kalmcollective.co.za/terms.html

## Product information

KS Active Archive product pages provide current descriptions, colour options, pricing and availability. KALM Move is presented as Launching Soon with product information, plain prices, wishlist and launch-notification registration; it is not purchasable.

## Customer terms

KALM Collective's customer Terms & Conditions page covers delivery, order cancellation, returns and refunds, together with customer-care information.

## Crawling

Machine-readable discovery files are available at /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml. Access is subject to the crawler's own robots policy and does not guarantee indexing or AI inclusion.
